selected_observations.excerpt:
Effective: 4 June 2021
Term: 24 months. The agreement auto-renews for successive 12-month periods unless either party gives 90 days' written notice before the then-current term ends.

selection_rationale: Auto-renewal term language is the primary lifecycle evidence; judgment requires applying notice mechanics to the evaluation date.
known_missing_information: No notice-of-non-renewal or side letter on file.
